research_question: does the already-qualified frozen theta_1 repeatedly improve genuinely later deployable-domain prediction without closed-loop degradation

model_pair.theta_1_source: C-B one-step study commit 130f16e; never refit in this replication

replications.unit: one independently seeded paired A/B rollout
replications.seed_selection_rule: exclude deterministic original seed 20260824, then take the next three consecutive Stage-5 controller-search seeds before outcomes

transition.arm_b: theta_0 then exactly one switch to frozen theta_1
transition.causal_trigger: first OUTBOUND deployable sample with episode_time_s >= 3.045

decision.RPL_A: all three independent rollout means favor theta_1, no rollout is formally NEGATIVE, moving-phase direction is repeated, and no matched closed-loop or registered-safety regression occurs
decision.RPL_B: two or more rollout means favor theta_1 without degradation, but direction or phase evidence remains inconsistent or too weak
decision.RPL_C: one or fewer rollout means favor theta_1, a formal NEGATIVE occurs, or a meaningful matched closed-loop regression occurs
